newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude advances in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude advances in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea bellwether Brent crude advanced in late U.S. paper trading on Wednesday, with two full boats changing hands, traders said.
A top trading house bought a pair of August Brent cargoes for $19.45 a barrel each, up seven cents from the IPE settlement in London.
Two partial August cargoes traded lower at $19.37 and $19.38 a barrel.
July/August Brent was dealt four times, three times at minus 13 cents a barrel, and once at minus 14 and a half cents. The spread was traded earlier between minus 14 and minus 10 cents.
